title: Your professor’s “quick favor”
scenario: An email from a professor’s display name says they are in a conference session and need you to buy gift cards for visiting speakers. They promise reimbursement from the department tomorrow.

answers.A: Buy the cards but do not send the codes until the professor confirms later.
answers.B: Verify with the professor or department through a known channel before buying anything.
answers.C: Ask for the request to go through normal university purchasing or an administrator.

explanation: Authority plus helpfulness can bypass normal controls. Gift-card requests should still follow university purchasing rules.
proTip: A professor’s title does not suspend procurement.
